content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, congrats on locking it in.

Next up, get a firm headcount to the venue since that usually drives their final setup and sometimes pricing. Then lock the menu or catering plan with them, if you haven't already picked one.

After that it's the finer stuff, timing for the night, any AV or music needs, and who's on the guest list so you can get invites out with a few weeks of runway before the 14th.

What's most pressing for you right now, the headcount or the guest list?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
